jobs.title: Shopify Solution Architect
jobs.excerpt: DemandPDX is a Salesforce Crest [Gold] Partner and Shopify Plus Partner with the #1 highest ratings for Salesforce Commerce Cloud on Salesforce AppExchange.
jobs.description:
DemandPDX is a Salesforce Crest [Gold] Partner and Shopify Plus Partner with the #1 highest ratings for Salesforce Commerce Cloud on Salesforce AppExchange. With more than 450 eCommerce sites under our team's collective belts, we have some of the most experienced developers, architects, business analysts, testers, and project managers in the business. Our entire team resides in the United States.

We are looking for an experienced Shopify Solutions Architect to help enterprise brands plan, architect, and execute complex Shopify implementations and replatforms.

This is not a purely advisory architecture position. We are looking for someone who can lead technical conversations with clients, participate in sales and discovery, design enterprise Shopify solutions and the broader ecosystem of systems surrounding Shopify, and still be hands-on when needed.

Here’s some of the benefits to working at DemandPDX

  • 35 or 40 hour work weeks
  • Work remotely
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Competitive salary
  • Bonus incentives
  • Free Medical, dental, vision and disability insurance for employees
  • HSA plan options
  • Higher limit Simple IRA plan with 3% company match
  • Free Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays
  • Paid time off
  • Maternity leave w/pay
  • Paternity leave w/pay
  • Bereavement leave w/pay
  • Natural disaster leave w/pay
  • Company laptop

Do you enjoy helping large brands determine not just how to build something, but what they should build and why?

Can you walk into a discovery session, understand an existing enterprise commerce ecosystem, identify requirements and risks, and design a Shopify architecture that will support the brand for years to come?

Can you determine how Shopify should integrate into a larger technology ecosystem that may include an ERP, OMS, PIM, inventory and fulfillment systems, marketing platforms, payment providers, tax platforms, CRM, and other enterprise systems?

Are you equally comfortable discussing architecture with a CTO, walking business stakeholders through technical tradeoffs, helping a sales team scope a potential project, and getting into the code when needed?

If so, we'd like to talk.

As a Shopify Solutions Architect at DemandPDX, you will provide technical leadership across the full lifecycle of enterprise Shopify engagements, from pre-sales and discovery through architecture, implementation, launch, and ongoing optimization.

You will work directly with prospective and existing clients, our sales team, project managers, business analysts, designers, and engineers to design scalable Shopify solutions for larger and more complex brands.

NOTE: We are only accepting applicants with significant Shopify Plus and enterprise eCommerce implementation experience.

Responsibilities

  • Provide eCommerce strategy and guidance for clients wanting to replatform to Shopify.
  • Collaborate with clients, account managers, and creative teams to gather requirements, define project scopes, and recommend technical solutions.
  • Architect and implement custom Shopify themes, features, and functionality tailored to the unique needs and branding of each client.
  • Develop and maintain Shopify apps, integrations, and third-party services to enhance e-commerce capabilities and user experiences.
  • Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards, and ensure adherence to best practices across projects.
  • Proactively identify technical challenges, propose innovative solutions, and implement effective resolutions to optimize client outcomes.
  • Stay updated on Shopify platform updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies, and leverage this knowledge to drive continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance throughout the project lifecycle, from planning and estimation to execution and delivery.

Requirements

  • 5 years of experience in developing and customizing Shopify-based e-commerce solutions, preferably within an agency or consulting environment.
  • Proficiency in Shopify platform architecture, including themes, Liquid, APIs, and app development.
  • Strong expertise in front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design principles.
  • Experience leading and managing a team of developers, with a collaborative and client-focused approach.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, with a track record of analyzing complex issues and delivering innovative solutions.
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies, project management tools, and version control systems.
  • Shopify Developer certifications (e.g., Shopify Plus Certified, Shopify App Developer Certification) are a plus.

Remote Work

  • This position qualifies for remote work anywhere in the United States.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer ( 102-08SENG-01 )
jobs.excerpt: This role builds and extends AWS landing zones, account vending and networking for enterprise migrations — the infrastructure and automation specialism, distinct from the Microsoft-workload and data-focused roles on the same program.
jobs.description:
This role builds and extends AWS landing zones, account vending and networking for enterprise migrations — the infrastructure and automation specialism, distinct from the Microsoft-workload and data-focused roles on the same program. The scope for year one: 191 applications in the estate being migrated to AWS across 20 business departments, 27 Azure subscriptions and 451 resource groups to map into an AWS account structure, and 5 migration waves to support, each with its own cutover windows and rollback plans. The landing zone itself — account vending, guardrails and centralized networking — is something you'll help build and run, not just consume.

Requirements

What you will do

  • Build and extend AWS multi-account landing zones with Control Tower, account vending and service control policies.

  • Design and implement hybrid networking — VPC architecture, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect and VPN back to on-premises and Azure.

  • Write and maintain Terraform modules that other engineers depend on.

  • Automate delivery through CI/CD — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or CodePipeline.

  • Operate containerized workloads on EKS with Helm and Argo CD where in scope.

  • Write runbooks and hand over to client engineering teams; knowledge transfer is part of every engagement.

Required

  • Production experience writing and maintaining Terraform modules at scale. The single most important skill for this role.

  • Strong AWS networking: VPC design, routing, Transit Gateway, VPN and hybrid connectivity.

  • Deep AWS platform knowledge: compute, storage and IAM. AWS Solutions Architect Associate or higher expected.

  • Comfortable on Linux, with Bash and Python to a working standard.

  • Production CI/CD experience: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or CodePipeline.

  • Demonstrated experience building or operating a multi-account AWS landing zone.

  • Professional written and spoken English.

Nice to have

AWS Control Tower, Terragrunt, Kubernetes/EKS, Helm, Argo CD, Ansible, Azure, VMware, AWS DevOps Professional, Serverless/Lambda, GuardDuty/Security Hub, PCI-DSS environments.

Engagement details

  • Full-time

  • Start date: February 2027

  • Open to candidates from all LATAM

Highlights

Terraform, AWS (Control Tower, VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPN, IAM, compute, storage), Linux, Bash, Python, CI/CD , Kubernetes/EKS, Helm, Argo CD, Terragrunt, Ansible, Azure, VMware

jobs.title: Technical Product Support Specialist, Enterprise
jobs.excerpt: What Do We Do? Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommmerce.
jobs.description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommmerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the most actionable AI in commerce — Moby 2 — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby 2 doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Pressed Juicery, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

What You're Applying for

Triple Whale's enterprise customers are some of the most sophisticated operators in DTC - multi-brand, multi-region, often agency-supported, running custom stacks and making eight-figure decisions on our data. They deserve a support experience built for that complexity.

As an Enterprise Technical Product Support Specialist, you'll be the dedicated technical voice for a book of our most important accounts. You'll go deeper than a typical support conversation - understanding each account's business goals, their data stack, the way their team and agencies use Triple Whale, and what "good" looks like for them - so every interaction moves them closer to the outcomes they came to us for.

This is a technical role with real ownership. You'll have Moby as a copilot, close partnership with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, and Marketing Science, and a clear path to grow into Solutions Architecture, Implementation, Support Engineering, or Product if that's where you want to go.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond to enterprise customers across live chat, email, and direct channels, owning every conversation from first contact through resolution with the communication and follow-through these accounts expect.
  • Maintain deep knowledge or internal and customer resources. The customer KB, internal runbooks, product docs, Moby context, and the right person to ping for anything you can't answer yourself - so you can resolve quickly and confidently every time.
  • Be deeply fluent in Triple Whale, the ecommerce stack our customers live in, and the attribution, marketing-data, and AI workflows that drive their decisions - including the more complex surfaces enterprise customers rely on (Compass, Sonar, custom integrations, data warehouse, headless and custom checkouts).
  • Investigate and resolve complex technical issues across pixel, integrations, reporting, Moby, and beyond. Know when an account needs education, guidance, configuration, a bug filed, or an escalation to Engineering - and write reproduction steps your engineering partners can act on immediately.
  • Use Moby as your copilot. This is an AI-first support team. You'll partner with Moby to investigate, retrieve, draft, and resolve - and your work helps make Moby more useful for the next customer.
  • Coach enterprise customers and their agencies on best practices, workflows, and use cases that move them toward their goals, especially when something time-sensitive or high-stakes is on the line.
  • Partner closely with the account team. Work hand-in-hand with CS counterparts to keep the customer aligned across every Triple Whale touchpoint - and know when to pull in the right specialist.
  • Be a senior escalation point for the broader Technical Product Support team on enterprise-grade complexity, and a steady hand when accounts are stressed.
  • Spot patterns across tickets. Surface recurring issues, customer feedback, and friction to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success - and help the next account avoid what you saw this week.
  • Help the next customer. Contribute to the knowledge base, internal runbooks, and Moby context - so what you learned today helps both your accounts and the broader team tomorrow.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, customer success, solutions, or another client-facing technical role - with at least 1+ year supporting enterprise or mid-market SaaS accounts, ideally in martech, analytics, attribution, or ecommerce.
  • A technical mind with depth. You're comfortable in dashboards, you can reason about data, you can read API responses and basic logs, and you understand how systems like pixels, server-side tracking, ad-platform integrations, and data warehouses connect. SQL fluency is a strong plus.
  • An investigative, problem-solving mindset. You don't stop at "the error says X" - you want to know why, and you're comfortable reaching for AI tools to move faster.
  • A real interest in customer outcomes. You care about what enterprise customers are trying to accomplish in their business - and you're willing to learn the business deeply enough to actually help.
  • Composure under pressure. Enterprise accounts have higher stakes, multiple stakeholders, and sometimes urgent escalations. You stay clear, structured, and calm.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can speak the language of an operator, an engineer, an agency partner, and an exec - and tailor the message to each.
  • A customer-first instinct paired with the judgment to recommend what'll actually serve the customer best, even when it's not what they asked for.
  • Comfort partnering across teams. Enterprise support doesn't work alone - you'll be in regular contact with CSMs, SAs, Marketing Scientists, and Engineering.
  • Familiarity with Intercom, HubSpot, Jira, or similar support and ticketing platforms.

Our Values

  • We Are Customer Obsessed: From our mission to every detailed project, everything we do is designed to create a positive impact for our customers.
  • We Move (Very!) Quickly: The speed at which we work, iterate, and deliver value is our most competitive advantage.
  • We Are Trustworthy: Candor, directness, and honest communication helps us learn, grow and improve so we can win together.
  • We Are Curious: We extend beyond our comfort zone and ask questions that guide us towards new, creative, and bold paths.
  • We Act Like A Mensch: We act with honor, integrity and empathy, and have deep respect for our customers and each other.

Base Compensation Range: $65,000 - $80,000

Our compensation ranges are set using benchmarks from growth-stage companies and factor in function, level, and location—so everything stays balanced and competitive. The range listed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salary across all U.S. locations.

Triple Whale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Software Architect III – Life Insurance Solutions ART (Train Architect)
I/S Life Insurance Solutions | Mutual of Omaha Information Services

Mutual of Omaha is seeking a forward‑thinking Software Architect to turn business needs into clear architecture requirements and bring a strong customer perspective to our Life Insurance Solutions technology decisions. Operating as the Train Architect, you will serve as the architectural authority for the LIS ART by directing architecture traffic, ensuring alignment across teams, and partnering closely with enterprise architects and senior IS leadership to maintain a consistent, forward-looking technology vision. In this role, you’ll help drive key strategic initiatives, applying Artificial Intelligence (AI tools) to drive modernization of core platforms such as improving application and underwriting experiences, enhancing the customer and associate experience, and accelerating delivery through innovation. We’re looking for a technically strong, collaborative leader who can influence teams and deliver modern, secure, scalable solutions. As the Train Architect for the Life Insurance Solutions Agile Release Train (ART), you'll partner with business and technology teams to build solutions that support multiple products and use cases across the value stream. From day one, you'll play a lead role in two high-priority initiatives: shaping the API architecture strategy for our enterprise eApplication (eApp) platform designed to deliver a consistent producer experience across all product lines, and advancing our embedded insurance strategy, which explores new digital partnership channels that bring life insurance to customers at the point of need.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary: Minimum: $170,000 - $190,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
  • Benefits and Perks: 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time, and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Growth & Development: A clear architecture career path with opportunities to grow into an Architect IV (director-level) role, transition into engineering or people leadership, or expand your experience through cross-functional exposure across other Agile Release Trains. We invest in our architects and actively support your next move, whatever direction that takes you
  • Eligibility: Applicants must not now, nor in the future, require employment sponsorship

This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Architecture Leadership: Design and implement advanced software solutions, enabling loosely coupled enterprise-scale components across the teams. Drive legacy modernization by decomposing monolithic systems into loosely coupled, event-driven microservices architectures.
  • Strategy & Planning:Collaborate with enterprise architects and business stakeholders to define a vision and roadmap for solution modernization, experimentation, and governance aligned to strategic outcomes.
  • Innovation & Prototyping:Lead the development and identification of use cases and PoCs, as well as prioritize maintenance and automation opportunities. Explore “what-if” scenarios, whiteboarding, and design sprints to evaluate new opportunities and validate business impact.
  • Governance & Ethics:Establish and uphold standards for software quality, stewardship, ethical AI practices, and secure solution deployment while promoting regulatory compliance and trust.
  • Mentorship & Enablement:Coach engineers and analysts in feature engineering, AI use and development, fostering a culture of curiosity and continuous improvement. Promote knowledge sharing and establish best practices across teams.
  • Collaboration & Integration:Integrate solutions with microservices, event-based architectures, and external business partners, ensuring scalability, observability, and operational readiness.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • 5+ years of experience in leading software architecture initiatives, including cloud-native platforms, software development lifecycle management, governance, and CI/CD.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, RDBMS, and event-based cloud technologies (AWS preferred), with experience deploying and maintaining APIs. Experience in prototyping, experimentation, refining scope, and scripting/automation to build, test, and maintain software solutions.
  • Strong and mature understanding of, and commitment to, software engineering and architecture principles and governance.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to interpret data, manage risk, and provide sound, innovative recommendations.
  • Advocacy for change and bias for action toward results as a trusted advisor.
  • This role supports a hybrid work model for candidates based in the Omaha, NE area, or may be performed fully remote for candidates located elsewhere in the United States
  • Comfortable working in agile environments and guiding architecture for Agile Release Trains (ART). Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional leadership skills.

PREFERRED:

  • Financial services, Insurance or regulated industry experience
  • TOGAF Certified.
  • SAFe certification (SA, SPC, or RTE-adjacent experience)
  • C4 architecture methodology experience
  • Experience with AWS – S3, Bedrock, SageMaker, EC2, Connect, CDK, SDK, etc.).
  • Practical familiarity with autonomous AI systems
  • Participation in industry groups and/or communities of practice.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

  • Azure Networking: Design and implement robust Azure networking solutions, including Virtual Networks (VNets), Subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Azure Firewall, Load Balancers, Application Gateway, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, Private Endpoints, DNS, and hybrid connectivity.

Design Kubernetes clustering strategies covering node pool optimization, high availability, workload isolation, and multi-cluster management.
  • Scalability & Performance: Architect automated scaling solutions for applications, containers, compute resources, and storage platforms to dynamically support enterprise workloads.
  • Data Lakes & Analytics: Develop enterprise Data Lake architectures using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and integrated modern analytics platforms.

  • Secure Knowledge Systems: Design secure enterprise AI capabilities that leverage internal organizational knowledge bases while maintaining strictly isolated data boundaries and IL5 compliance.
  • Integrations & Hybrid Systems: Architect secure API integrations and hybrid connectivity mechanisms bridging cloud-native services with existing on-premises legacy infrastructure.
  • Governance & DevSecOps: Establish enterprise cloud governance using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep), Azure Policy, Landing Zones, and automated DevSecOps pipelines.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Provide high-level technical leadership, architectural oversight, and mentoring across engineering and implementation teams.

Technical Environment

  • Cloud Platform: Azure Government (IL5), Azure Landing Zones, Hybrid Cloud
  • Identity & Security: Microsoft Entra ID, Zero Trust Security, RBAC, Conditional Access, IL5 Compliance Controls
  • Networking: VNets, NSGs, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateways, Application Gateways, Private Endpoints
  • Containers & Orchestration: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker, Helm, ACR, Kubernetes Clustering

  • Automation & DevOps: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / Bicep), Azure Policy, DevSecOps, CI/CD Pipelines

Qualifications

  • Azure Government (IL5): Deep expertise in Azure Government IL5 compliance controls, including network segmentation, security architecture, and DoD Zero Trust principles.
  • Architecture & Migration: Proven track record of leading end-to-end migrations of legacy on-premises applications to secure cloud-native environments.

This is a remote position.

Director of IT Operations

About the Role

The Director of IT Operations is responsible for the day-to-day delivery, reliability, and security of the company's IT environment. This leader owns the people, processes, and technology behind change management, the service desk, end-user support, infrastructure operations, and operational security. Reporting to the CIO/VP of Technology, the Director of IT Operations sets the standard for operational discipline, audit readiness, and service quality across the organization.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has built operational programs from the ground up, who can sit equally well in a Change Advisory Board, an executive readout, or a Sev 1 bridge call, and who measures success in uptime, audit findings, ticket SLAs, and team development.

Key Responsibilities

Change Management & Governance

  • Own the enterprise change management program, including policies, workflows, and approval gates for all production changes.
  • Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB), facilitating risk review, implementation readiness, rollback planning, and final approval of change requests.∙Ensure 100% compliance on deployment plans, test evidence, rollback procedures, and post-change validation for every production change.∙Maintain complete audit trails and documentation in the ticketing system (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow) to support internal and external audits.

Help Desk & End-User Support

  • Lead the IT service desk and end-user support function, setting SLA targets for response, resolution, and customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee employee onboarding/offboarding, device provisioning, access management, and lifecycle support for laptops, peripherals, and software.∙Drive continuous improvement in ticket quality, first-contact resolution, knowledge base coverage, and self-service capability.
  • Develop tiered support structure (Tier 1 through Tier 3) with clear escalation paths and ownership.

Incident & Problem Management

  • Own the full incident lifecycle: detection, triage, escalation, communication, resolution, and post-incident review.
  • Coordinate cross-functional response on Sev 1 and Sev 2 incidents, including executive communication and bridge facilitation.
  • Drive root cause analysis (RCA), corrective action tracking, and closure for all high-severity events.
  • Establish and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual availability, outage, and trend reporting for senior leadership.

Infrastructure Operations & Monitoring

  • Oversee 24x7 monitoring, alerting, and operations functions across production and corporate environments.
  • Own the operational monitoring and observability stack (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, PagerDuty, Site24x7), ensuring detection coverage, alert quality, and on-call effectiveness.
  • Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to ensure operational readiness of new services before release.

Security & Compliance

  • Partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to maintain SOC, PCI, and other applicable audit readiness across IT operations.
  • Enforce access controls, change controls, and operational security standards across systems and endpoints.
  • Serve as the operational point of contact for auditors, evidence gathering, and control attestation.

Vendor & Asset Management

  • Manage relationships with hardware, software, and managed service vendors (e.g., Dell, CDW, MSPs).
  • Oversee IT asset lifecycle, procurement forecasting, license management, and cost accountability.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, coach, and develop a multi-functional IT operations team across change, service desk, support, and operations.
  • Set performance standards, mentor staff, and create career growth paths from Tier 1 through senior roles.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

Required Qualifications
  • 10+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in IT operations leadership or management.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a formal change management program, including CAB chairmanship and audit accountability.
  • Strong track record managing 24x7 operations, incident response, and SLA driven service delivery.
  • Experience supporting SOC, PCI, or comparable audit frameworks with measurable compliance outcomes.
  • Hands-on familiarity with modern monitoring, ticketing, and collaboration tooling (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, PagerDuty, Site24x7, Jira, Confluence).∙ITIL-aligned understanding of Incident, Change, and Problem Management.∙Proven ability to build process structure from the ground up and translate operational data into executive-level reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; equally effective with engineers, auditors, and senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ITIL v3/v4 Foundation (or higher) certification.
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, fintech, payments).
  • Experience leading or supporting M&A integration, ERP transitions, or major platform migrations.
  • Background that spans hands-on technical work and senior leadership (e.g., progression from help desk through operations management).

What Success Looks Like

  • Zero audit findings related to change management and operational controls.
  • Sustained reduction in Sev 1 and Sev 2 incidents year over year.
  • Service desk consistently meeting or exceeding SLA and CSAT targets.
  • Clear, trusted operational reporting that leadership relies on to make decisions.
  • ​A high-performing, well-developed IT operations team with low attrition and visible internal growth.

jobs.description:
About Us:

For over 10 years, New Law Business Model (NLBM) has been on a mission to liberate lawyers from outdated, soul-crushing practice models. We provide the heart-centered framework—Life & Legacy Planning®—and the high-octane membership products required to build thriving, relational firms. With a community of 800+ Personal Family Lawyer® firms nationwide, we leverage elite AI and automation to amplify humanity, delivering the practical education, tools, and "done-for-you" systems lawyers need to reclaim their time and build a lasting legacy. We obsess over real-world outcomes, not just vibes, to ensure our members move from survival mode to true flourishing.

The Mission

This Member Care Specialist role is for a high-touch, relationship-oriented operator who can balance fierce empathy with extreme operational rigor. You'll love this role if you're energized by building genuine relationships, keeping things organized and moving, and being the steady, reliable presence that guides estate planning attorneys through their membership journey from day one.

You are equal parts member advocate, systems navigator, and clear communicator who takes pride in follow-through, consistency, and making sure no one falls through the cracks.

You should not apply if you struggle with high-volume CRM management, prefer to work in isolation, or dislike working cross-functionally across technical, product, and coaching teams.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

You’ll own the full lifecycle of assigned member accounts across our product portfolio, acting as their primary operational contact from onboarding through retention.

Pillar 1: Membership Support & Tiered Triage

  • Serve as members' first point of contact for day-to-day support requests, answering emails and inquiries directly and resolving them within SLA response and resolution targets. Escalating to Coaching, Solutions Engineers, Product, or Web Developers when specialized follow-up is needed.

  • Maintain an active account roster, proactively monitoring engagement, check-ins, and survey signals to identify at-risk members early and ensure lawyers are adopting our systems, executing retention interventions and coordinating tier upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and reactivations as needed.

  • Troubleshoot access, setup, and implementation issues for members, coordinating with Operations, LBSCs, and Onboarding Specialists to keep the experience cohesive.

  • Manage ticket pipelines for assigned accounts, ensuring accurate tagging, prioritization, and timely resolution within defined SLAs.

Pillar 2: Core Memberships Product Support

  • Serve as a key point of contact for Core Membership members, supporting day-to-day needs and troubleshooting access and setup issues directly or in collaboration with Operations.

  • Field and triage member support tickets to the appropriate teams (Coaching, Solutions Engineers, Product, or Web Developers), maintaining ticket hygiene and fast resolution times.

  • Coordinate closely with Coaches and Onboarding Specialists to ensure a cohesive and aligned member experience across touchpoints.

  • Facilitate administrative and resource support for Group Coaching calls, ensuring a seamless feedback loop between members, product managers, and coaches.

Pillar 3: Retention Intervention & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Identify at-risk members early through data and direct interactions, executing structured retention interventions or escalating concerns to Member Care leadership.

  • Coordinate cross-brand transitions, including membership tier upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and reactivations with care, clarity, and precision.

  • Surface operational trends, member friction points, and product suggestions to internal teams to drive continuous improvement in our overall learning experience.

What “Success” Looks Like

  • Members on your roster feel genuinely supported,and that shows up in high active engagement and CSAT/NPS scores month-over-month.

  • At-risk members are identified early and receive timely, structured outreach that keeps them engaged and progressing.

  • Members transition smoothly across product offerings with clear communication and no gaps in experience.

  • Support tickets are triaged and resolved rapidly with clear CRM documentation and zero missed follow-ups.

Who You Are

  • You have a proven track record in high-touch account management, member success, or client support, ideally within a membership, coaching, or SaaS environment.

  • You lead with empathy and genuine care, and members feel that in every interaction.

  • You are technically fluent, comfortably navigating HubSpot CRM, project management software (Asana), and digital product ecosystems, picking up new tools quickly as our systems evolve.

  • You are a proactive problem solver who spots disengagement risks early and coordinates across internal teams to drive resolution.

  • You demonstrate meticulous detail orientation and process discipline, keeping notes, tickets, and pipeline statuses accurate in real time.

  • You follow established processes with consistency and care, and you're not afraid to flag gaps or ask for direction when you need it.

  • You possess exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating complex technical or administrative steps into simple, actionable member guidance.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Position Type: Full-Time, Non-Exempt (W2), 40 Hours / Week.

  • Hourly Base Wage: $25.00 – $31.25 / hour (Equivalent to $52,000-$65,000 / annually based on 40 hours/week, depending on experience and qualifications

  • Work Schedule & Compliance: Dedicated 8-hour daily shifts during business hours. As a non-exempt role, all hours are tracked in real time using company software (Clockify), with full state-mandated meal/rest break compliance and pre-approved overtime compensated at 1.5x regular pay.

  • Location: 100% Remote (US-Based)

  • Benefits: Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision package; 401K Retirement Program; Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays.

Why Join NLBM?

  • 100% Remote Work at a Profitable, Growing Company

  • Recession-Proof Industry, Product, and Audience

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package (Health, Dental, Vision)

  • 401K Retirement Program

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Opportunities for Career Growth and Leadership Development

  • Be Part of a Mission-Driven Company Transforming the Legal Industry

At NLBM, you’ll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact, scale your career in leadership, and be part of a passionate, supportive team driving innovation and change.

This role operates under a Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) model. Employees are expected to provide their own computer and internet connection, meeting minimum requirements (including at least 16GB RAM) to perform work duties. The company provides required software and system access, and reimburses reasonable and necessary business expenses as required by law.

New Law Business Model (NLBM) respects your time and work. Any portfolio materials, technical breakdowns, or operational insights submitted during this application process are requested solely for the purpose of assessing your qualifications for this position. NLBM will not use, publish, or commercially exploit any material submitted during your application process without your express written consent. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that any skills assessments do not create an employment relationship or a contract for services.

New Law Business Model is an equal opportunity organization. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture. All qualified practitioners are encouraged to apply.

Highlights

Join NLBM and own the member journey for estate planning attorneys by providing high-touch support, driving system adoption, and resolving billing friction to ensure firms thrive from day one.

jobs.excerpt: POSITION SUMMARY:Under the general direction of the Manager of Revenue Integrity, the Senior Coding and Revenue Integrity Analyst exists to ensure compliant charge capture and revenue tracking for both Boston Medical Center (BMC) and the professional Boston University Medical Group (BUMG) revenue.
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Under the general direction of the Manager of Revenue Integrity, the Senior Coding and Revenue Integrity Analyst exists to ensure compliant charge capture and revenue tracking for both Boston Medical Center (BMC) and the professional Boston University Medical Group (BUMG) revenue. Operating under limited supervision and working independently, this role monitors regulatory changes, payer requirements, and revenue integrity policies to support compliant coding and billing practices across the enterprise. The position functions as a critical analytical liaison across both hospital and professional billing environments, performing comprehensive reimbursement analysis and developing detailed resolution plans to mitigate institutional revenue leakage. This role drives cross-functional collaboration and fosters constructive relationships between clinical revenue-producing departments and core revenue cycle teams to proactively resolve workflow deficiencies.

Position: Senior Coding / Revenue Integrity Analyst

Department: Revenue Integrity

Location: Remote with the occasional need to visit onsite

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

  • Revenue Cycle Initiative Leadership: Leads complex revenue cycle initiatives and large-scale optimization projects across high-revenue-generating or at-risk clinical departments to improve overall revenue integrity, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

  • Project Work Plan Management: Develops and executes detailed project work plans, timelines, and resolution frameworks for complex, multi-departmental revenue initiatives with limited managerial oversight to ensure timely delivery of operational goals.

  • Epic System Workflow Validation: Monitors, audits, and validates active charging workflows within Epic and intersecting third-party charging interfaces to ensure technical baseline accuracy and appropriate system build configuration.

  • Root Cause Data Analysis: Analyzes Epic work queue data and revenue performance metrics to execute structural root cause analysis, identify localized workflow deficiencies, and present formalized interpretations and actionable findings to leadership.

  • Departmental Sourcing Support: Manages charging, coding, and billing processes within clinical departments by auditing revenue-producing activities to verify compliance with evolving government regulations and third-party payer contract requirements.

  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Collaboration: Partners with departmental stakeholders, finance leaders, and revenue cycle teams to assess active clinical workflows, troubleshoot system issues, and deliver targeted training and analytical feedback.

  • Subject Matter Expertise & Escalation Support: Serves as the primary functional subject matter expert and institutional liaison for charge capture, supporting complex escalation issues and guiding cross-functional revenue cycle partners.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).

JOB REQUIREMENTS

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Associate’s degree in Business, Healthcare, or a related field; and at least five (5) years of healthcare experience, including at least two years in an active role involving coding, auditing, finance, revenue cycle management, and/or physician billing (preferably within an Academic Medical Center setting); or equivalent combination of education and experience.

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a closely related field, combined with five (5) or more years of progressive revenue integrity experience within a matrixed health system.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist – Physician-based (CCS-P), or Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA).

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Advanced Process and Root Cause Analysis: Advanced proficiency in process analysis, troubleshooting, and database investigation to structurally isolate billing deficiencies and engineer actionable solutions.

  • Healthcare Revenue Cycle Principles: Strong working knowledge of materials management, purchasing, contracting, and vendor management structures as they intersect with hospital charging systems, Epic, and nThrive applications.

  • Objective Data Synthesization: Advanced analytical skills to evaluate complex utilization datasets from multiple disparate sources, develop summary metrics, and translate findings into current, accurate procurement and billing recommendations.

  • Strategic Communication and Presentation: Superior written and verbal communication skills, including the objective ability to present complex fiscal trends, regulatory interpretations, and systemic recommendations to senior administrative and physician leadership.

  • Independent Project Management: Strong organizational and time management skills to manage deadlines, prioritize personal workloads, and autonomously drive multiple concurrent project plans.

  • Stakeholder Influence and Interviewing: Strong active listening and interviewing skills to gather relevant workflow data from clinical personnel and establish collaborative working relationships across diverse medical and administrative teams.

  • Office Application Competency: Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Forms, to execute automated operational reporting and project tracking.

Compensation Range:

$78,000.00- $113,000.00

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensures as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), discretionary annual bonuses and merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family well-being.

NOTE: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.

At ERGOMED Group, our pharmacovigilance teams protect patients around the world and we're looking for a Global HR Business Partner who wants to do the same for our people.

This is a rare opportunity to sit at the intersection of HR strategy and one of the most mission-critical functions in pharma - pharmacovigilance. If you're energized by complexity, thrive in matrixed, multi-country environments, and want your HR expertise to have a direct line to patient safety outcomes, this is your role.

  • Genuine comfort operating across time zones, cultures, and regional nuance.

  • Experience across workforce planning, organisation design, talent, leadership development, engagement and change.

  • A data-driven and commercially minded approach, with the ability to turn people insights into action Experience navigating organizational change and complex structures.

  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the credibility to advise senior stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel when needed to stay close to the business.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together.   • Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, technical assessments, and root-cause analyses.

Team Leadership and Management

Program and Delivery Management

  • Translate business, functional, security, and contractual requirements into technical plans and deliverables.
  • Develop project estimates, staffing plans, delivery schedules, milestones, and risk-mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor project scope, schedule, quality, budget, resource utilization, dependencies, and technical risks.

jobs.excerpt: Job Requisition ID # 26WD100660Autodesk is seeking a Senior Customer Trust Incident Response Manager to help lead the customer-facing response to security, privacy, and service availability incidents that impact, or have the potential to impact, Autodesk customers.
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #


26WD100660

Autodesk is seeking a Senior Customer Trust Incident Response Manager to help lead the customer-facing response to security, privacy, and service availability incidents that impact, or have the potential to impact, Autodesk customers.

In this role, you will represent the customer perspective throughout the incident lifecycle. You will work alongside technical incident responders, product and engineering teams, cloud and site reliability teams, privacy and legal partners, identity teams, and customer-facing organizations to understand what has happened, determine what customers need to know, identify unanswered questions, and drive accurate and timely customer communications.

You will not necessarily be the technical incident commander or the person responsible for remediating an incident. Instead, you will be the person asking: What does this mean for our customers? Who is affected? What do they need to know? What questions will they ask? What can we confidently communicate now, and what do we still need to determine?

You will translate complex, rapidly evolving technical information into clear, accurate, and actionable communications for customers and Autodesk teams. Depending on the incident, these communications may include direct customer notifications, customer and support guidance on phone calls, security bulletins or advisories published through the Autodesk Trust Center, service communications, and Autodesk Event Analyses published through the Autodesk Health Dashboard.

This is a highly collaborative role requiring strong technical judgment, exceptional written and verbal communication, customer empathy, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to operate calmly and effectively during high-pressure situations.

Responsibilities

Represent the customer during Trust incidents

  • Actively participate in the response to significant security, privacy, data protection, identity, and product or service availability incidents that impact or may impact Autodesk customers.
  • Serve as the Customer Trust lead within incident response activities and ensure customer impact, customer expectations, and communication requirements are considered throughout the response.
  • Rapidly develop an understanding of the incident, affected products or services, impacted customers, relevant data or systems, potential customer consequences, remediation activities, and expected recovery.
  • Identify gaps in the information needed to understand and communicate customer impact.
  • Ask direct, technically informed questions of incident responders, engineers, product teams, and other subject matter experts and drive those questions to resolution.
  • Anticipate the questions customers, customer executives, administrators, security teams, and technical teams are likely to ask.

Drive customer incident communications

  • Develop clear, accurate, timely, and appropriately transparent customer communications during rapidly evolving incidents.
  • Translate complex technical, security, privacy, and operational information into language appropriate for customers without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Coordinate and contribute to direct notifications to impacted customers when required.
  • Develop or coordinate Trust Center security bulletins and advisories, Autodesk Event Analyses, FAQs, talking points, and other incident-related customer materials.
  • Maintain consistency across communications delivered through Customer Support, Customer Success, account teams, Trust Center channels, Health Dashboard channels, and other customer-facing teams.
  • Work with technical and legal stakeholders to distinguish between confirmed facts, preliminary findings, working hypotheses, and information that is not yet appropriate for external communication.
  • Balance the need for speed and transparency with technical accuracy, customer usefulness, privacy obligations, security considerations, and legal requirements.

Coordinate across Autodesk

Build strong working relationships across organizations involved in Trust incidents. During an incident, you will bring these perspectives together to establish a coherent understanding of customer impact and help ensure the right information reaches the right customers and Autodesk teams at the right time.

Improve Autodesk's customer Trust incident response capabilities

  • Participate in incident retrospectives and identify opportunities to improve customer communications and the overall customer experience during incidents.
  • Help develop and mature Customer Trust incident response processes, playbooks, communication templates, escalation criteria, and decision frameworks.
  • Establish repeatable approaches for assessing customer impact and determining appropriate communication channels and audiences.
  • Partner with incident response and operational teams on exercises, simulations, and tabletop scenarios to ensure customer considerations are incorporated into incident preparedness.
  • Identify recurring customer questions and communication challenges and use those insights to improve future incident response.
  • Help define metrics and measures for the effectiveness and timeliness of customer trust incident communications.
  • Promote a culture in which customer trust is treated as a critical component of incident response

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant professional experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Security or cybersecurity incident response
    • Technical incident management
    • Site reliability or cloud service incident response
    • Senior technical support, escalation engineering, or customer support
    • Technical or product marketing, especially in the cybersecurity industry
  • Demonstrated experience working directly with customers on complex, technical, sensitive, or high-severity issues.
  • Strong technical understanding of modern cloud and SaaS environments, including:
    • Networking and Internet technologies
    • Web applications and APIs
    • Cloud infrastructure and services
    • Identity, authentication, authorization, and access management
    • Application and product security concepts
    • Data storage, processing, and data flows
    • Distributed systems and service dependencies
    • Availability, reliability, and operational incident concepts
  • Exceptional written communication skills, including the ability to produce concise, technically accurate customer communications under significant time pressure.
  • Strong verbal communication skills and confidence working directly with technical experts, senior leaders, legal professionals, customer-facing teams, and customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to remain calm, organized, and effective during high-severity or rapidly evolving incidents.
  • Ability to be diplomatic while asking direct questions, challenging assumptions, and driving clarity when information is incomplete.
  • Experience working in a global organization and coordinating incident response across multiple regions and time zones.

Learn More


About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.


We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.


When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!


Salary transparency


Belonging

Farmer Mac is looking to hire a driven, analytical, industry-focused and personable individual for a Senior Portfolio Analyst - Infrastructure position on its renewable energy infrastructure portfolio management team. The position will support Farmer Mac’s Infrastructure Finance team.

Position Summary

The role will be responsible for supporting Farmer Mac’s existing portfolio of complex renewable energy project finance loans to finance independent power projects, including loans to projects that are under construction or those that are operational, and construction bridge loans that monetize tax credits. Credit Analyst will interact and coordinate closely with other members of the Infrastructure Finance team, which includes Credit Underwriting teams, Relationship Managers, and Portfolio Strategy & Analytics within our Renewable Energy, Broadband Infrastructure, and Power & Utilities business segments. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, preparing and managing loan modification/consents/amendment requests, performing ongoing risk rating assessments and required reviews, loan refinancing transactions, legal document review, coordinating with loan operations on reviewing and processing borrowing and disbursement requests, interfacing with internal stakeholders, including Underwriting, Credit, Capital Markets, and Loan Operations. Additionally, this role will support underwriting of new loans, preparation of credit memos, performing and managing due diligence activities, industry and market analysis, preparing and/or reviewing complex cash flow project finance models, closing activities, and assist in the execution of loan purchases.

This role is expected to immediately contribute towards accelerating growth within Farmer Mac’s Infrastructure Finance business and significantly contribute to Farmer Mac’s strategic objectives and initiatives. Suitable candidate must be a proactive self-starter, be able to work on and assist in completing various deals at multiple stages of development, work with minimal supervision and be an active and efficient communicator.

Team Summary

Farmer Mac’s Infrastructure Finance team is a fast-paced, knowledgeable, mission-oriented team lending to organizations that finance renewable energy project finance transactions, power and utility entities and broadband companies, in addition to providing wholesale lending to a select group of financial institutions. Infrastructure Finance has delivered significant growth and is a crucial business in the execution of Farmer Mac’s strategic plan. The segment’s focus is on deepening existing client relationships, developing new customer relationships, and diversifying the products offered to clients.

The People You Will Work With

The Senior Portfolio Analyst will be an integral part of the Infrastructure Finance team, reporting directly to the Portfolio Manager - Renewable Energy and will have regular ongoing interactions with the Underwriters, Managing Directors within Infrastructure Finance, Capital Markets, Transaction Management, and internal and external advisors and legal counsel.

Where and When You Will Work

The position can be based in Farmer Mac’s Washington, DC or Johnston, IA, locations or remote. Farmer Mac embraces a Presence with Purpose work environment, which allows for flexibility of work location while providing the opportunity for teams to come together in the office with purpose. Work outside of core hours may be required for planned and unplanned activities to complete time sensitive projects or to attend off-site meetings or events.

Primary Responsibilities and Duties

  • Support Infrastructure Finance loan performances and collaborate with key internal stakeholders, including Credit, Underwriters, and Relationship Managers.
  • Collaborate with the Portfolio Strategy & Analytics and the Credit team to support strategic credit assessments of the portfolio, ensuring alignment with business strategies and performance goals as outlined in Farmer Mac’s business plan.
  • Work closely with Portfolio Strategy & Analytics to:
    • Prepare and manage loan modification/consents/waivers/amendment requests, term conversion, legal document reviews,
    • Coordinate with Loan Operations on reviewing and processing of borrowing and disbursement requests,
    • Gather appropriate project information and documents for due diligence and provide support to credit underwriters, as necessary,
    • Assist in creating management reports that include quarterly monitoring of portfolio deals as well as portfolio trends and statistics.
  • Gather and assess industry information to understand macro impacts on the portfolio and individual transactions.
  • Interact closely with Underwriting to support loan acquisitions in alignment with Farmer Mac policy and standards.
  • Support risk rating assessment and ongoing management of loan portfolio and required reviews.
  • Assist in underwriting analysis and credit approval memos when necessary.
  • Work closely with the Managing Director of Renewable Energy in the development of policies and procedures that drive efficiencies across the business.
  • Assist and support the ongoing development of loan administrative, operations and closing functions, and the implementation of infrastructure projects.
  • Represent Farm Mac at industry conferences and individual lender visits.
  • Support organization wide initiatives and processes to improve efficiency, productivity, sourcing and credit quality.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with Farmer Mac staff and clients
  • Proficiency in operating in a computerized office environment, with solid ability in all MS Office applications, especially focused on PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, Power BI, and Copilot
  • Familiarity with and ability to become proficient with Farmer Mac’s online loan origination and servicing platforms and applications
  • Strong work ethic with the ability to work on one or more tasks efficiently and effectively with minimal supervision
  • Fundamental understanding of finance and accounting, particularly energy finance, public accounting, banking, or related experience.
  • Self-starter mentality with high intellectual curiosity.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, economics, engineering or related field.
  • Four to six (4-6) years of experience in finance, commercial banking, renewable energy or other energy-related fields.

Our compensation philosophy is targeted pay positioning relative to peers, our industry, and external markets. Farmer Mac is committed to a compensation program that will enable the organization to attract, motivate, reward, and retain highly skilled and creative talent to maintain sustained long-term performance and achieve the organization’s strategic business objectives. Salary is competitive. Extensive experience in teaching, translation, or community-based linguistic projects can substitute for a formal degree. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Carioca language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

Customer Success Manager DACH (m/w/d) – Teilzeit / Contractor

Wir suchen eine strukturierte und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Kunden in der DACH-Region unterstützt und ihnen hilft, das volle Potenzial von Abler zu nutzen.

Die Rolle startet in Teilzeit (ca. 10–20 Stunden pro Woche) und bietet die Möglichkeit, mit unserem Wachstum in der Region weiter zu wachsen.

Abler wird bereits von Organisationen im Umfeld von Clubs wie Chelsea F.C., Newcastle United oder Barcelona genutzt. In England arbeiten wir mit rund 40% der Clubs aus den Top 4 Ligen zusammen. Auch in Deutschland haben wir bereits erste Kunden und bauen unsere Präsenz weiter aus.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass wir eine sehr starke Value Proposition haben und echten Mehrwert für Sportorganisationen schaffen. Unser Ziel ist es, diese Qualität und Struktur auch im Breitensport verfügbar zu machen.

Wenn du die richtige Einstellung und Motivation mitbringst, unterstützen wir dich mit allem, was du brauchst, um in der Rolle erfolgreich zu sein.

Die Rolle

  • Du arbeitest eng mit neuen und bestehenden Kunden zusammen und stellst sicher, dass sie Abler erfolgreich einsetzen.
  • Dazu gehören das Onboarding neuer Vereine, die Unterstützung im täglichen Umgang mit der Plattform sowie die Beantwortung von Fragen.
  • Du bist Teil unseres Customer Success und Support Teams und arbeitest mit klaren Prozessen. Gleichzeitig hilfst du aktiv dabei, unseren Ansatz für Kundenbetreuung und Implementierung im DACH-Markt weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du sammelst Feedback aus dem Markt und bringst es in unser Produktteam ein, um sowohl das Produkt als auch unsere Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Je nach Interesse kann die Rolle auch Aufgaben im Bereich Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung umfassen, z. B. bei der Identifikation potenzieller Kunden oder erster Business-Development-Aktivitäten.
  • Gelegentlich können auch persönliche Besuche bei Kunden Teil der Rolle sein.

Arbeitsweise

  • Remote-first Rolle (Arbeiten von zu Hause)
  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung im Rahmen der Teilzeit
  • Möglichkeit zur Unterstützung von Co-Working-Spaces je nach Bedarf
  • Gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Termine bei Kunden

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding neuer Vereine und Begleitung beim Setup
  • Unterstützung von Kunden im täglichen Einsatz von Abler
  • Beantwortung von Fragen und Sicherstellung einer positiven Nutzungserfahrung
  • Sammeln und Weitergeben von Kundenfeedback an das Produktteam
  • Mitgestaltung unserer Prozesse für Customer Success und Implementierung in DACH
  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Hilfsmaterialien und Guides
  • Unterstützung bei Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung bei Bedarf

Das bringst du mit

  • Freude daran, Menschen zu helfen und Probleme zu lösen
  • Bezug zum Sport (z. B. als Spieler, Trainer oder im Verein)
  • Sicher im Umgang mit gängigen digitalen Tools (Du musst nicht hoch technisch sein, solltest aber offen sein, neue Systeme zu lernen (wir schulen dich auf Abler)
  • Strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Wohnsitz in der DACH-Region
  • Erfahrung mit Abler ist ein Plus
  • Spanischkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus (Unterstützung in anderen Märkten möglich)

Das erwartet dich

  • Flexible Teilzeitrolle mit Entwicklungsperspektive
  • Remote-Arbeitsumfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Unterstützung bei Co-Working-Space möglich
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team
  • Klare Prozesse, Einarbeitung und Unterstützung
  • Möglichkeit, aktiv Einfluss auf Produkt und Arbeitsweise zu nehmen

Über Abler

Abler entwickelt das Betriebssystem für Sportorganisationen.

Unsere Plattform wurde in Island entwickelt, einem Land mit einem der stärksten organisierten Sportsysteme weltweit. Island gilt international als Vorzeigemodell für erfolgreiche Sportentwicklung. Heute nutzen rund 75 % der gesamten Isländishen Bevölkerung Abler im Kontext von Sport - alles vom Breitensport bis hin zu professionellen Strukturen.

Unser Ziel ist es, Sportorganisationen besser zu machen und dadurch die Entwicklung von Menschen und Gemeinschaften durch Sport zu fördern.

Sport matters.

. Alle Bewerbungen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Please note that this position is fully remote. That said, if you are based in Poland, Portugal, or Ukraine, you are welcome to use our local offices whenever it suits you.

About the role

PandaDoc is hiring its first Design Engineer to sit at the intersection of design and engineering in the Embedded Agreements track. You'll own the design of two strategic areas — our API and our integrations — the surfaces that connect PandaDoc to the broader ecosystem of tools our customers already work in.

The Embedded Agreements track is where PandaDoc extends beyond the product itself. Our API is where developers build on top of PandaDoc, embed document workflows into their own products, and connect to AI-native environments — including our ChatGPT app, Claude connector, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration. Our integrations area is where users connect PandaDoc to the tools they already use, like Salesforce and HubSpot, to automate document workflows across their stack.

And the ground is shifting. The technical barrier to working with programmatic surfaces like our API is falling fast: MCP and AI surfaces like Claude and ChatGPT are collapsing the effort it takes to connect to an API or an MCP server. That means the audience for these surfaces is no longer just developers — it's a larger and growing group whose expectations are changing as quickly as the way developers themselves now build. We're looking for someone who can partner closely with product to help define our strategy here, stay close to how the market is moving, and let that shape how we design these surfaces for an expanding audience.

Both areas are technically complex and require someone who can hold the developer experience and the end-user experience in mind at the same time. This is a role for someone who has the eye of a designer, understands and can ship code, and is genuinely excited about building for developers and an increasingly broad set of power users. You will own a strategic area end to end. We expect you to be opinionated, deeply curious about how people and tools interact, and comfortable shaping a product area with limited prior template.

What you'll do

  • Own the design of our API and integrations areas end to end — from developer-facing API surfaces and documentation experiences to the in-product flows users rely on to connect their tools;
  • Partner with product and research to shape strategy for these surfaces — staying close to how the market and the audience are shifting as the barrier to working with APIs and MCP falls, and translating that into how we design for a broader, evolving set of users;
  • Design and prototype AI-native patterns for our API — including our ChatGPT app, Claude connector, and MCP integration — surfaces where PandaDoc meets AI assistants and agentic workflows;
  • Shape how integrations feel across the product, with intent around two questions in particular: how our core CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot) need to adapt for an agentic world, and how we balance the integrations we build ourselves against the connections customers orchestrate for themselves in surfaces like Claude via MCP — when each makes sense, when a hybrid is right, and how to design an experience that intentionally guides customers to the best option for them;
  • Prototype ideas in code, fast. Take a concept from Figma or an LLM conversation to a working production-grade React component in days, owning layout, interaction, accessibility, and performance;
  • Trailblaze the Design Engineer function at PandaDoc. Own work end to end, from problem framing to launch, and shape how this role operates as the first hire in it;
  • As the only Design Engineer on the Embedded Agreements team, bring your technical perspective into the design process — sharing patterns, pairing on prototypes, and helping the designers around you improve their technical skills over time;
  • Work AI-first in Cursor and Claude Code, and bring strong opinions on how to get high-quality output from these tools.

What you need

  • Strong experience across both design and front-end engineering, with a portfolio of shipped interfaces or widely-used components you can point us to;
  • Fluency in React, TypeScript, modern CSS, and comfort working close to API surfaces and developer tooling;
  • A genuine interest in developer experience — you understand what makes an API feel well-designed, not just functional — and curiosity about how that experience is broadening beyond developers as MCP and AI assistants lower the barrier to entry;
  • Active, opinionated use of Cursor and Claude Code in your daily workflow, with a clear point of view on how to get production-quality output;
  • Comfort building from zero, with the judgment to set direction when there's no template to follow, and the instinct to partner with product on where the market is heading.

Our stack

React, TypeScript, our internal AI-enabled design system, Figma, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot. You're not expected to have shipped in all of these, but you should be excited to work close to product, AI, and real users.

Ardent is seeking a Geospatial Scientist, Data Collection and Quality to join our team.

This is a remote position.

Position Description:

Ardent is seeking a Geospatial Data Collection and Quality Manager that will serve as the primary point of contact for acquiring new geospatial data critical to Homeland Security missions. This role requires advanced expertise in geospatial data management, acquisition, quality control, and stakeholder engagement to ensure delivery of high-value, licensed, and mission-relevant data products. This position supports data acquisition, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), documentation of processes, and effective communication with data providers and internal teams to maintain a high standard of geospatial data integrity and usability.

Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Lead the development and refinement of methodologies for geospatial data collection, acquisition, and maintenance ensuring alignment with mission needs.
  • Manage data intake, prioritize data needs based on use cases from DHS components and Mission Partners, and ensure quality control throughout acquisition and delivery processes.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to data acquisition, refresh, quality assurance, and data publishing.
  • Oversee budget management for data acquisition to secure high-priority and high-value data products.
  • Define and enforce requirements for geospatial data including accuracy, coverage, resolution, formats, licensing, update frequency, and system compatibility.
  • Maintain comprehensive lists of data providers and datasets; identify and engage high-quality geospatial data providers.
  • Utilize professional networks and government guidance to identify potential new data sources and providers.
  • Manage procurement or production activities to ensure timely delivery of high-quality, licensed geospatial data.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with data providers regarding data use, dissemination, security, quality, and acceptance criteria.
  • Negotiate licensing agreements and purchasing options to achieve best value while ensuring compliance with usage permissions.
  • Provide technical support and oversight to ensure data products meet acceptance criteria and mission requirements.
  • Facilitate technical demonstrations and presentations of geospatial data and analyses for stakeholders and Mission Partners.
  • Support integration of data products into government systems and ensure seamless coordination with other program activities.
  • Lead QA/QC efforts, including data review, validation, and application of standardized checklists to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Manage feedback loops with data users and providers to identify and implement content improvements and resolve data quality issues.
  • Develop and maintain geospatial metadata, ensuring completeness, consistency, and usability for downstream applications.
  • Automate data processing workflows where feasible, maintaining documentation and tools for reproducible data review.
  • Oversee data registration, cataloging, publication, hosting, and federation within government geospatial platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and regulations (e.g., FGDC, ISO) and apply best practices in geospatial data lifecycle management.
  • Monitor and analyze performance metrics and user feedback to continuously improve data acquisition and management processes.
  • Maintain documentation of all processes, data integration plans, and QA/QC plans to support program transparency and continuous improvement.
  • Inform government stakeholders promptly of any issues impacting cost, schedule, or performance.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience leading geospatial data acquisition and quality management activities in complex government or commercial projects.
  • Expertise in geospatial sciences including cartography, GIS, data management, and geospatial infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage vendor/provider relationships and negotiate data licensing and acquisition contracts.
  • Experience developing and applying QA/QC procedures and standards to geospatial datasets.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills to engage with technical teams and mission partners.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, and geospatial data processing tools.
  • Familiarity with geospatial data standards, metadata management, and federal data policies.
  • Proven track record managing large-scale data projects with multiple stakeholders and distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience supporting DHS or other federal agency geospatial programs.
  • Familiarity with commercial and open-source geospatial tools and platforms.
  • Experience with federated data architectures and integration of RESTful geospatial services.
  • Advanced knowledge of geospatial data lifecycle management and best practices.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate complex data delivery schedules.
  • Strong network within the geospatial data provider community.

Due to the nature of the work we support, all candidates in consideration for this role must be willing to undergo the government issued background investigation process. We highly encourage all Veterans and those with disabilities to apply.

  • Legacy & Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world’s first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships.

🧭 Navigating the position: Software Tester

We are seeking an experienced Software Tester to take ownership of testing activities within the VCPM tribe. You will design, implement and execute tests across vessel navigation, route planning, weather data and maritime voyage management, driving quality through the full delivery lifecycle. You will work closely with developers, product owners and stakeholders to ensure our software meets both functional and non-functional requirements.

Technology context: Our systems involve REST and real-time APIs, geospatial data, vessel communication protocols, event-driven architectures and cloud-based data streaming. Our systems are safety-critical. Defects in navigation or weather data can have serious operational consequences. Rigorous API and integration testing is core to everything we do.

🚢 Your Voyage Ahead:

  • Design, write and execute comprehensive test cases based on requirements, user stories and risk analysis
  • Perform exploratory testing to uncover defects beyond scripted test coverage
  • Raise, triage and manage defects through to resolution, working closely with developers

  • Maintain and improve existing regression suites, identifying candidates for automation
  • Contribute to sprint retrospectives with actionable quality observations

  • SQL proficiency for test data setup, validation and database-level verification

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience with API automation (e.g. Postman collections, Newman, RestAssured)

  • Basic scripting ability (Python, JavaScript, or similar) for test data generation or automation support
  • Experience in the maritime, logistics, or regulated industry domain

Behaviours & Ways of Working

  • Analytical thinker who can translate complex requirements into clear test conditions
  • Confident communicator able to articulate quality risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Takes ownership of quality outcomes, not just test execution
  • Collaborative and supportive of less experienced team members

Hello, we’re Instrumentl. 👋

Nonprofits do some of the most important work in the world, and most of them are still managing grants in spreadsheets. We’re fixing that.

Instrumentl is a profitable, hypergrowth, YC-backed SaaS platform building the operating system for grant-funded organizations.
